name: A Curious Pair
summary: In the Sepulcher, Trevan Rol spots an unusual pair passing through Silverpine Forest. The tauren and high elf travel under the Earthen Ring's banner, a rare sight in Horde territory that draws suspicion.

sections.title: Eyes in the Sepulcher
sections.body: Trevan Rol sees two travelers claiming to represent the Earthen Ring pass along the road by the Sepulcher. The outpost is a grim waystation where strangers, especially those on diplomatic business, draw close scrutiny. A tauren traveling under the shamanic order's banner raises little surprise. His cloaked companion is another matter: the scout recognizes an unmistakable high elf, a sight that strikes the Forsaken as exceedingly strange.

sections.title: A Peculiar Partnership
sections.body: A high elf traveling openly beside a member of the Horde's shamanic circles raises questions among the Forsaken sentries. The Earthen Ring concerns itself with the balance of the elements, and high elves are rarely seen in Lordaeron, much less as companions to tauren envoys. To learn where the pair went and what business brought them to the forest, you are directed to Deathguard Baldren at the edge of town.

faq.q: Who are the two travelers mentioned in this quest?
faq.answer: Trevan Rol says the travelers presented themselves as Earthen Ring dignitaries. One is a tauren, while his cloaked companion is a high elf.

faq.q: Why is a high elf traveling with a tauren so unusual?
aliases: why is high elf with tauren weird
faq.answer: The high elves have ties to the Alliance and arcane magic, while tauren belong to the Horde and practice shamanism. Seeing them travel together through Horde-controlled Silverpine Forest under the Earthen Ring is rare and suspicious.

faq.q: Who starts the quest A Curious Pair?
aliases: where to pick up a curious pair
faq.answer: Trevan Rol gives the request in the Sepulcher, an outpost in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Where do I find Deathguard Baldren?
faq.answer: Deathguard Baldren watches near the Sepulcher's entrance in Silverpine Forest, keeping an eye on travelers along the road.

The Earthen Ring is an ancient shamanic organization devoted to preserving the balance of the elements and healing spiritual discord throughout the world. Its members are mostly shamans, including tauren and orcs, though its diplomats sometimes travel to distant lands.

faq.q: Is the high elf an enemy to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Trevan Rol does not know whether the high elf is an enemy. The elf is cloaked and travels under diplomatic pretense beside a tauren, so the Forsaken question their purpose rather than attack outright.

angles.text: Even experienced shamans find the Earthen Ring traveling with an elf unusual. The Ring's traditions rarely involve the quel'dorei.
As a tauren, you may feel conflicted seeing one of your kin travel through Lordaeron beside an elven stranger, watched closely by Forsaken sentries.
As Forsaken, you know that outsiders passing through Silverpine Forest warrant close scrutiny, especially amid Lordaeron's fractured political climate.
